overview: Prometheus servers scrape targets discovered via service discovery, store locally, and ship blocks to object storage; Thanos queries across shards; Alertmanager handles alerts.

estimation.assumption: Illustrative fleet: 10K hosts × 1K series, scraped every 15 s.
estimation.result: 15 days at 16 raw bytes/sample ≈ 13.8 TB before compression/replication.
estimation.implication: Control label cardinality; downsample historical blocks and separate ingestion from expensive queries.

steps.title: Prometheus scrape shards → Scrape targets
steps.explanation: Load scrape targets and stable shard assignments.

steps.title: Prometheus scrape shards → Host agents
steps.explanation: Pull /metrics every 15 seconds; record scrape health separately from metric values.

steps.title: Prometheus scrape shards → Local write-ahead log → TSDB writers → TSDB
steps.explanation: Append to a local WAL and persist samples to the local TSDB.

steps.title: Local write-ahead log → Block compactor → Historical TSDB blocks
steps.explanation: Compact/downsample completed intervals and upload immutable historical blocks.

steps.title: Dashboards → LB → Query Service → TSDB
steps.explanation: Read recent raw series with HA replica deduplication.

steps.title: Query Service → Historical TSDB blocks
steps.explanation: Read older downsampled data for long-range queries.

steps.title: Block compactor → Alert evaluator → Notifier → PagerDuty
steps.explanation: Evaluate alert rules and route deduplicated notifications.

failureCases.scenario: A target disappears or ingestion backs up
failureCases.handling: Track scrape failures and missing series separately from zero values. Alert on collection health, cap buffers, and expose dropped-sample counters rather than hiding data gaps.

alternatives: Use push collectors and a replayable stream for high ingest rates and short-lived producers. Use pull scraping with local WAL/TSDB for discoverable long-lived targets, adding object blocks and HA query deduplication for global retention.
